translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús dulapaa-gakambe na e-sapingan-barmisad
We-ibmar deyob gusad-sorba, Dummad-Jesús na e-sapingan-baigan e-dulapaa-gakambe, bela na e-naoed neggweburmarse ebo-ebo e-iduar barmisad.

Jesús amarga sogded: “Napira an bemarga soged, nainugi ibmar-gwag-weleged bukidarad, ar e-wemaladdina ichee gued. Degisoggu, nainugi ibdula-gwag-weleged-e-ibedse be wilesakwaa egismar, adi e-nainuse ibdula-gwag-wemalad-barmidagegar.
“Be namar, emigi an na be-barmidmar, bemar sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwadyob, achu-burburumalad-abargi.
Mer mor-sagu sedmalo, mani-sagu surbar, degi, sapat surbar, degine, igarba mer dulemarga suitii nued-sogeye sunmakgwichi be gumalo.
“Ar doa-negse be dogdapoe, agi bina be soggweloed: ‘We-neggi bemar gwage-bogidikidgi gudigusunye.’
“Ar a-neggine dule-gwage-bogidikidgi-nanaed maile, be-ega-sogsadyob a-dulegi gwage-bogidikidi beoed. Ar degisulirdi, be-ega-sogsadyob gwen guosulid.

Bemar unnila neg-gwagwenginbi be gabmaloed, degine, ibu bega gunnega, igi, gobega ukarmar-dibe, be gunno, be gobo. Ar ade dule-arbaed nue-bennukleged ega igar-maid, a-ular nabir bemar mas gunmogodo, degine, nabir gobbalodo. Mer neg-baid-baidgi gabdii-gumalo.
“Ar ibi-neggweburse be dogdapo-dibe, be-abingasmalale, ar ibi-mas-gunned bega ukarmalale, be gunnoed.
A-neggweburgi dulemar-uelemamaid be nudakoed, degine, dulemarga be sogoed: ‘Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid bemarse warmaksasunye.’
“Ar ibi-neggweburse be dogdapo-dibe, agi be-abingassurmalale, be e-galimbaba noalidgi, be sogoed:

‘Be neggwebur-olli anmar-sapatgi-nagusadse-bakar anmar eli-eli imakmar, bemargi gwisgumalagar. Adi dulemar mag be-dakmalagar, anmar bemarga Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmakapmarmoganad. Degisoggu, bemargindo, bemar yapa Bab-Dummad-igar-abingamalad. Wedi bemar wisgubi anmar abedo, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid bemarse warmaksasunnad.’
“Ani, Jesús, an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, neggwebur-be-abingassurmalad, Sodoma-neggweburba bur-bule sabsur odurdaklegoed.”
Jesús neggweburmar-sabsur-odurdaklegoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús sogdebar: “¡Corazín-dorgan be wilesmar! ¡Betsaida-dorgan be wilesmar! Ar bemar sabsur odurdaklenonikoed. Ar Tiro-neggweburgi, degi, Sidón-neggweburgi we-ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaklesana, a-neggweburmar bato dikasurgus sagumor yosmalanad, degine, burugi obsamarbalinad, adi oyogegar, emarde na e-iskuedga bukib ulubgi nue itosmarye.
Degisoggu, an bemarga sogsun, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabogoed-ibagangi, bemar bur-bule Tiro-dorganba, degi, Sidón-dorganba sabsur odurdaklemaloed.
“Emide bedi Capernaum-dorgan, na be nibnegse-onakwiles-gusadyobi, be-nug-ogannoles-gusanad. Emigindi, uluba-odurdakleged-negse odelegoedyob, be-nug iskunonikoed.”
Jesús, dulapaa-gakambe barminaidga sogdebar: “Ar dulemar be-itomalale, an-itomardo. Ar dulemar be-abingasurmalale, an-abingasurmardo. Ar dulemar an-abingasulile, dule-an-barmialid-abingasurmardo.”
Jesús-sapingan gannar Jesússe nonikid
E-dulapaa-gakambe Jesús barmisadi gannar nonimargu, ise-weligwar-ito nonimalad, Jesúsga sognonimalad: —Dummad, niamarse-bakar be-nuggine anmarba ibmar imasmalad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Mer be dummarba na san itomalo. Ar nia-saila-Satanás na-dummarba-itosadbali an daksad, nibneggi mar-gaedyob argwate.”

Jesús e-sapinganga sogdebar: “Emide be dake, bemarga gangued an uked, naibemar-birgi, degine, diormar-birgi annaegar, degine, bela be-istarad-Satanás-ganguedgi, nakwegar. Amar gwen be-oakalogosurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, mer bemar weligwar itomar niaburbamar bemar-sogedba ibmar imakedgi, bur be wergumar, bemar-nug nibneggi narmakar-naid-ular.”
Jesús nue-weligwar itosad

Geb agi Jesús Bab Dummad Burba Nuedba nue-weligwar ito naded, sogded: “Baba, an be-nug odummosun, bedi nibneg, degine, napneg e-Dummadid, degine, bedi dulemar-ibmar-wismaladgi, dulemar-ibmar-magar-itomaladgi, an we-ibmarmar imaksad, aku-ito be imaksad, dulemar-baisursunnagwadga bur be osanalosad, adi amar magar itomalagar. Eye, Baba, ar ade deyob be abesad.”

Jesús sogdebar: “Bela-ibmarmar an-Bab anga uksad. Dulemar wargwensaar Bab-Dummad-Machi-mag-daked satemalad, unnila Bab Dummadbi mag daked, degi, Bab-Dummad-aku-dakmarbalid, unnila E-Machibi mag Bab-daked, ar doaga E-Machi na e-Bab-osanalobie, agarbi na osanaloged.”
Jesús na e-sapinganse aibilidgu, amargarbi sogded: “Dulemargi we nued egi binsalesad, dulemar bemar-ibmar-dakedyob dakmarmogad.

Ar ani an bemarga sogmalad, bukidar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad, degi, reymar, emi-bemar-ibmar-daked, dakbi-gusmalanad, amar gwen daksasurmalad, degi, amar emi-bemar-ibmar-itoged, itobi-gusmalanad, amar gwen itossurmalad.”
Samaria-dor-nuedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Agine, Moisés-igar-mamaid-oduloged-wargwen, gwisgualid, Jesúsga sogded, yamo yardakegar: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿burba-geg-bergued an nikuegala, ibu an imaker-gebe?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Bab-Dummad-igar-maidgi igi narmakar maisunna? ¿Igi be absodisunna?
A-dule, abin-imakdegu, sogded:
Jesús aga sogded: —Nued be an-abin-imaksad. Ar be sogsadyob be imakdo, geb agi be degi-sadegu dula gudiguoed.
Ar Moisés-igar-maid-oduloged-nue-wisid na dukin nudakbisoggu, Jesúsga sogded: —¿Degite, doa-dule-baid an sabguer-gebsunna?

Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: “Ibagwengi dule-wargwen Jerusaléngi aidedani-gusad, Jericóse. Igarba danigu, atursamalad argangingusad. Atursamalad sarsosmargu, bela ei-ibmar susmalad, burgwedani mete nadmalad.
“Dakargu, Judio-wargwen, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, a-igarba aidedani-gusad. Dule-yegus-mellemaid daksagu, egi bakar nade-gusad.
“Amba deyob Judio-baid, Levita, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bendaked-wargwen, dule-yegus-maid walikgusgu, daksamogu, egi bakar nade-gusmogad.
“Ar dule-wargwen, Samariagined, igarba nadapmogu, dule-yegus-maid-daknonimogad. Ar we-dule Judiosur-inigwele, dule-yegus-maid-dakdegu, nue-wile dakded.

Samariagined dule-yegus-maidse warmakdapgu, nailikusmaladgi ega ina imaksad, ibmar-gwallu, degi, vino, egi eosad. Geb degi ega nue morgogi edichabalid. Degine, Samariagined e-moli-birgi dule-nailikusad-onakwisgu, meged-negse senonikid, degine, agi nue akwisad.

“A-banedgine, Samariagined nasokargu, mani-gwabo onosad. Neg-dakedga mani uksagu, ega sogded: ‘Nue we-dule be anga ako. Degine, igi-mani-napi egi be misale, gannar an aibilisar, an be-bennuknonikoed.’ ”
Moisés-igar-maid-oduloged-nue-wisidga Jesús sogded: —Be itogua, we-dulemar-e-warbaagwad ¿doa bur dule-nailikusad sabedgi bendas be itosunna?

Moisés-igar-maid-oduloged-nue-wisid Jesúsga sogded: —Ar dule bur-nue dule-nailikusad wile daksad, a-dule bur dule-baid nue sabgusdo. Geb degi Jesús ega sogded: —Samariagined dule-baid-bendaksadyob, deyob be imaknamosundo.
Jesús, Martase, degi, Maríase atakapid
Jesús na e-sapinganmala igarba nadapgu, neggwebur-gwensakse dogdapid. A-neggweburgi ome-wargwen, Marta-nugad, na e-neggi Jesús-abingasad.
We-omede urba-nikad, Maríaye-nuga. María Jesús-walik sigisad, Jesús-ibmar-odurdaked itosii-gusad.
Ar Martadi ibmar-saedginbi binsanaisoggu, obir-obir gunaisunnad. Marta Jesúsga sogded: —Dummad, ¿emi be baisur dake, an-urba wargwen arbaega an-imaknaigu? Degisoggu, ega be soge, wis an-bendakye.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Marta, Marta, surbinsa be itonaid, degi, obir-obir be itonaid ibmar-yaisur-saedba.
Ar unnila ibmar-soggwenbi bur-nuedid. María ibmar-soggwen-nued bur susad, an-sunmaked-itogegar, a-ibmar Maríagi gwen egwallegosulid.
